subject: Post-call: PrismPay security pack request & milestone plan
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@prismpay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: PrismPay security pack request & milestone plan

Hi Lina / Tom (cc'd security),

Thanks again for taking time today — good conversation. Per our call, this thread captures the pain we heard, the artifacts PrismPay needs for your internal risk review, and a proposed short milestone plan so your security and procurement teams can evaluate us quickly. I focused the asks on SOC 2 + retention + pen test evidence since those were highest priority.

Key pain / acceptance criteria you shared
- Need SOC 2 Type II auditor report (or roadmap to it) and evidence mapping for controls in scope (especially CC6/CC7 related to logging and change control).
- Audit log access: reviewers want to know how long API/audit logs are retained, where logs are stored, and whether logs can be exported to the customer's SIEM.
- Data retention & deletion: PrismPay must be able to define retention windows per customer and receive deletion confirmations for regulated accounts.
- Pen test evidence: summary of last pen test, remediation status for any critical/high findings, and confirmation of scoped IP ranges.
- DPA items: standard DPA with negotiated retention and subprocessors list (you requested a redline).

Artifacts we will provide (first pass)
- Redwood evidence index (PDF): maps SOC 2 control to artifacts and owner. [Attachment: redwood-evidence-index.pdf]
- Audit log retention doc: retention windows, S3 bucket details, export options (syslog/CloudWatch/forwarding).
- Pen test summary: scope, date, critical/high findings + remediation owners.
- DPA draft: baseline with editable sections [Attachment: redwood-dpa-draft.docx]
- SOC 2 checklist for you to annotate: What you need from us vs. what we'd ask you to provide [Attachment: prism-pay-soc2-checklist.xlsx]

Proposed milestone / sprint (short timeline to get you to risk signoff)
1) Artifact pull & alignment (3 business days): we deliver the evidence index + pen test summary + log retention spec. Owner: Stephanie. Due: 2027-07-22.
2) DPA redline and negotiation (5 business days after artifact pull): we deliver a redline and scheduling for legal sync. Owner: Stephanie / Legal. Due: 2027-07-29.
3) Technical verification / SIEM export test (2 business days): Marcus to run a live export demo of audit logs to your test SIEM. Owner: Marcus. Window: 2027-07-26 - 2027-07-28.
4) Final acceptance & procurement handoff: PrismPay signoff -> procurement. Target: 2027-08-05.

Immediate asks for you
- Please confirm the list of PrismPay reviewers (names + emails) so we can route artifacts to them.
- Confirm whether the SIEM export should be S3/CloudWatch/syslog and provide a test endpoint if you want us to demonstrate.
- Any specific retention windows (e.g., 90 days, 1 year) we should highlight in the artifact pull.

I'll attach the initial index and DPA draft in my next message (small files). Marcus will follow with the log-export test plan. Let us know if that timeline looks good.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0184

Thanks, Stephanie — this is very helpful and matches what our reviewers asked for. Quick clarifications: 

1) Our security reviewer list:
- Tom Hale <tom.hale@prism-pay.com> (Head of Sec Ops)
- Aisha R. (senior security engineer) — I'll share her email shortly.
2) SIEM export: we prefer syslog -> our Splunk instance for the test. I'll DM you the test endpoint.
3) Retention: default retention for transaction-level logs is 13 months; session/audit traces 90 days. We may request exceptions for a small set of merchant accounts.

On pen test: we need the remediation status for anything marked high/critical. Is that included in the summary?

Agree to the timeline. Please send the index and DPA redline when ready.

-Lina

Hi Lina — quick answers from the technical side: 

- Pen test summary will include a remediation table for any high/critical items; we can also provide Jira tickets or PRs showing closure where available.
- Audit logs: we retain API/audit logs in an encrypted S3 bucket for 400 days by default; we can offer configurable retention down to 30 days for specific customers. Exports: we can forward via syslog or push to a test S3 bucket; for syslog we'll need your endpoint and an open port.
- Deletion confirmations: we can provide a signed deletion statement and object-level deletion logs showing removal time and requestor.

I'll prepare a short technical appendix for the evidence index that shows the log schema, retention TTLs, encryption at rest and in transit (KMS details), and who/what has IAM access. Marcus
